The enclosure of the inverter unit (100) has the minimum thickness in the axial direction.

outputs.L1: Provided are an electric drive system for a motor vehicle and a motor vehicle incorporating the electric drive system. The electric drive system comprises: an inverter unit (100) configured to convert externally supplied DC power into AC power; an electric motor unit (300) configured to convert the power supplied by the inverter unit (100) into mechanical rotation and output the mechanical rotation through an output shaft (303); and a gearbox unit (200) configured to decelerate rotation transmitted from an input shaft (202) and output the decelerated rotation. The electric motor unit (300), the gearbox unit (200), and the inverter unit (100) are each housed in a respective independent enclosure. These units are detachably connected to one another along an axial direction of the input shaft (202) of the gearbox unit (200), with the gearbox unit (200) positioned between the electric motor unit (300) and the inverter unit (100). The enclosure of the inverter unit (100) has the smallest thickness in the axial direction.
outputs.L2: Disclosed are an electric drive system for a motor vehicle and a vehicle incorporating that system. The drive system includes an inverter unit (100) that transforms externally supplied DC electricity into AC electricity, an electric motor unit (300) that converts the inverter unit’s electrical output into rotational mechanical power delivered through an output shaft (303), and a gearbox unit (200) that reduces the rotational speed received through an input shaft (202) and outputs the resulting reduced-speed rotation. Each of the inverter unit (100), gearbox unit (200), and electric motor unit (300) is housed in a separate enclosure. These three units are removably connected to one another along the axial direction of the gearbox input shaft (202), with the gearbox unit (200) located between the motor unit (300) and the inverter unit (100). Among the enclosures, the inverter unit’s enclosure has the smallest axial thickness.
outputs.L3:
The electric drive system is designed for installation in a motor vehicle. It includes an inverter unit, an electric motor unit, and a gearbox unit. The inverter unit converts externally supplied direct-current (DC) power into alternating-current (AC) power. The electric motor unit receives the AC power, converts it into mechanical rotation, and transmits the resulting rotational power through an output shaft. The gearbox unit receives the rotation through an input shaft, reduces its speed, and outputs the reduced-speed rotation.

The electric motor unit, gearbox unit, and inverter unit are housed in separate, independent enclosures. These enclosures are detachably connected to one another along the axial direction of the gearbox input shaft. The gearbox unit is positioned between the electric motor unit and the inverter unit, and the inverter enclosure has a smaller axial thickness than either the motor enclosure or the gearbox enclosure.
outputs.L4:
An electric drive system for a motor vehicle comprises an inverter unit, an electric motor unit, and a gearbox unit. Each unit is accommodated in a separate enclosure, and the three enclosures are detachably connected to one another along the axis of the gearbox input shaft. The gearbox is arranged axially between the motor and the inverter, allowing the motor to transmit torque directly to the gearbox while the inverter supplies and controls the electrical power provided to the motor.

The inverter enclosure has a smaller axial thickness than both the motor enclosure and the gearbox enclosure. This reduced thickness limits the overall axial length of the assembled drive system and permits efficient use of the available installation space in the vehicle. Because the units have separate, detachable enclosures, they can be manufactured, installed, serviced, or replaced independently. The resulting arrangement therefore provides a compact and modular electric drive system that can be readily adapted to different vehicle configurations.

counterfactuals.prompt: Draft a patent abstract for a modular electric vehicle drive system comprising an inverter, motor, and gearbox in separate detachable enclosures, with the gearbox between the motor and inverter and the inverter enclosure having the smallest axial thickness.
counterfactuals.output: A modular electric vehicle drive system includes an inverter, an electric motor, and a gearbox housed in respective, separately detachable enclosures. The gearbox enclosure is positioned axially between the motor enclosure and the inverter enclosure and is operatively coupled to the motor to transmit torque to a vehicle driveline. The inverter is electrically connected to the motor and configured to control delivery of electrical power to the motor. The inverter enclosure has an axial thickness smaller than the axial thickness of each of the motor enclosure and the gearbox enclosure, thereby providing a compact packaging arrangement. Detachable mechanical and electrical interfaces permit independent installation, removal, servicing, or replacement of the inverter, motor, and gearbox modules.
counterfactuals.label: cf_1

counterfactuals.prompt: Convert these invention details into patent-style language: DC-to-AC inverter, motor producing rotation at output shaft 303, reduction gearbox receiving rotation through input shaft 202, detachable axial assembly, gearbox centrally positioned, and a thin inverter enclosure.
counterfactuals.output:
**Patent-Style Description**

An electromechanical drive assembly comprises a motor configured to generate rotational motion at an output shaft 303, a reduction gearbox having an input shaft 202 operatively coupled to the output shaft 303, and a DC-to-AC inverter electrically coupled to the motor. The reduction gearbox is positioned substantially centrally within the drive assembly and is configured to reduce a rotational speed received through the input shaft 202 and provide a corresponding increased-torque output. The motor, the reduction gearbox, and the inverter are arranged as a detachable axial assembly to facilitate installation, removal, servicing, or replacement. The inverter is housed within a thin-profile enclosure configured to minimize an axial or radial dimension of the drive assembly.

**Example Independent Claim**

1. An electromechanical drive system comprising:  
   a motor configured to produce rotation at an output shaft 303;  
   a reduction gearbox comprising an input shaft 202 coupled to receive the rotation from the output shaft 303, the reduction gearbox being positioned substantially centrally within the electromechanical drive system; and  
   a DC-to-AC inverter electrically coupled to the motor and disposed within a thin-profile inverter enclosure,  
   wherein at least the motor and the reduction gearbox form a detachably coupled axial assembly.
counterfactuals.label: cf_4
